description: This is a test file for tenantClient utilities, utilizing Jest to test functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant. The tests cover normalization logic, fetching tenants, selecting a tenant, and localStorage management.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes different tenant ID representations to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches session tenants from the backend API.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, posts to API, and updates localStorage.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in localStorage, removing legacy keys.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from localStorage.
